PetrolWar.title: The Iran war is costing you R1,000 a month at the pump
PetrolWar.desc:
95 unleaded inland: R20.30 a litre in March 2026, R30.24 from 4 November. Up 49% in eight months.

A 50-litre tank: R1,015 in March, R1,512 now. R497 more every tank. Two tanks a month: almost R1,000 extra, every month.

Sources: DMRE monthly fuel price adjustments (March and November 2026). The November price includes the temporary R1.50/litre levy relief. Figures only; no position on the war. Not financial advice.

HouseAsset.title: Your house is not an investment: the 30-year maths
HouseAsset.desc:
A $400,000 home. 20% down, $320,000 mortgage at 6.5% over 30 years: $2,023 a month and $408,142 in interest. Add property tax (1.1%), insurance ($1,500) and maintenance (1%): about $10,000 a year, $297,000 over 30 years. Total paid: about $1.1 million.

Worth after 30 years at 3.5% a year appreciation: about $1.12 million. You broke even, and you had somewhere to live.

Illustration: fixed rate, costs held flat, ignores the rent you'd otherwise pay. Not financial advice.
#realestate #mortgage #housing #personalfinance #shorts

OnePercent.title: A 1% fee costs more than your house: R8.2 million over 40 years
OnePercent.desc:
R5,000 a month for 40 years: R2.4 million in.
At 10% a year: R31,620,398.
At 9% (after a 1% fee): R23,406,601.
The difference: R8,213,797. Gone, for 1% a year.

Nobody feels 1%. Everybody feels 8 million. Ask what you're paying.
Illustration: steady returns, compounded monthly, before tax and inflation. Real returns vary. Not financial advice.
#investing #fees #compoundinterest #personalfinance #shorts

Lotto.title: The lottery is a tax on people who can't do maths
Lotto.desc:
Lotto jackpot odds: 1 in 20,358,520. You're 58 times more likely to be struck by lightning (1 in 350,000, SA Weather Service).

R20 a week on tickets for 40 years: R41,600. The same R20 a week invested at 7%: about R227,484. Guaranteed by maths, not luck.

Play for fun if you like. Just don't call it a plan.
Illustration only: assumes a steady 7% yearly return, compounded monthly, before fees, tax and inflation. Not financial advice.

BankFees.title: Your bank charges you to hold your own money: R99 a month for 40 years
BankFees.desc:
Published 2026 fee schedules: a typical mid-tier account costs about R99 a month, a premium account R250. The cheapest accounts are under R10.

R99 a month for 40 years: R47,520 in fees. Invested at 7% instead: about R259,857.
R250 a month: R120,000 in fees. Invested: about R656,203.

Bundled accounts include transactions and rewards, so compare for your own usage. Illustration only: 7% a year, compounded monthly, before fees, tax and inflation. Not financial advice.

TwoPotNation.title: R43 billion out: the biggest retirement withdrawal in SA history
TwoPotNation.desc:
In the first five months of two-pot, SARS approved 2,403,379 withdrawals: R43.42 billion taken out of retirement savings, about R18,000 each before tax (SARS, to 31 January 2025).

Left invested for 25 years at 6% a year after inflation, that R43 billion would become about R194 billion in today's money.

Some people had no choice. Many did. Before you withdraw, do the maths.
Illustration: 6% real, compounded monthly, before fees. Withdrawals are taxed at marginal rates. Not financial advice.
#twopot #retirement #southafrica #sars #shorts
